name: Riu Palace Aruba - All Inclusive
description:
Located on the impressive Palm Beach, Hotel Riu Palace Aruba offers you the best facilities to enjoy an unforgettable break. This 24-hour All-Inclusive hotel on Palm Beach boasts a delicious and varied cuisine with extensive facilities and the best exclusive service that is characteristic of RIU Hotels & Resorts.
Hotel Riu Palace Aruba’s 400-plus rooms provide all the amenities you need to enjoy the utmost comfort, such as WiFi connection, satellite TV, air conditioning, a minibar and beverage dispensers. As part of the hotel’s facilities you will also find two outdoor pools and one kids’ pool to cool off in. And if you prefer hitting the beach, we can provide loungers and parasols for you to relax in Aruba’s warm climate.
There is no time to be bored in this All-Inclusive Palm Beach hotel thanks to the day and evening entertainment programmes, shows and live music for all ages. If you would like to practice some sport, you can visit the gym or practice beach volleyball, paddle surf and kayaking around the hotel. If you would prefer to relax, the Renova Spa at Hotel Riu Palace Aruba has a whirlpool bath and as well as a range of treatments you can book to return from your holiday completely refreshed.
You will be delighted by the variety of cuisine found at the Hotel Riu Palace Aruba. You can choose from five restaurants to enjoy buffet breakfasts with show cooking demonstrations, delicious fusion, Italian and Japanese cuisine, or savour select cuts in the steakhouse located in the pool area. There are also hotel bars in which to enjoy the best snacks and aperitifs, such as the Sports Bar, the patisserie, the ice-cream parlour and the swim-up pool bar. And if you want to have some fun in the evening, there is always the discotheque at Hotel Riu Palace Antillas.
Aruba is an authentic paradise for you to enjoy an unforgettable holiday. If you would like to learn a little more about the country we recommend that you visit some of its best natural settings, such as the Cura di Tortuga natural pool or Arikok National Park, and the capital, Oranjestad. For further information, please read our Aruba tourist guide and the best offers for Hotel Riu Palace Aruba. Discover Aruba with RIU Hotels & Resorts!

name: Riu Palace Antillas - Adults Only - All Inclusive
description:
The Riu Palace Antillas Hotel, a 24h All Inclusive resort, is located on the shores of Palm Beach, Aruba, immersed in the most selective Caribbean atmosphere. Its Adults Only service, exclusively for over 18 years old, is ideal for a fantastic and romantic vacation.
The hotel is the perfect place to relax; it offers a free gym and spa, a beauty salon, and a hairdressing service with a wide variety of treatments. Perfect for sun lovers, it provides free sun loungers, umbrellas, and towels both at its fantastic pool and on the beautiful Palm Beach. Additionally, a comprehensive entertainment program offers the chance to enjoy a variety of activities, including water sports such as snorkeling and kayaking. In the surrounding area, you will find a golf course, bike rentals, water sports like windsurfing and sailing, as well as the possibility of engaging in interesting hiking routes.
The buffet restaurant invites you to enjoy the colorful Caribbean cuisine at lunch and dinner. At the same time, you will find different world flavors in the three thematic restaurants. At night, you can also enjoy RIU’s entertainment program with shows, dancefloor or try your luck at the casino.
Enjoy the best offers of Aruba and spend some relaxing time at the Riu Palace Antillas.

name: Barcelo Aruba
description:
The 5-star Barceló Aruba hotel transports guests to a unique, seafront experience, on the Caribbean island of Aruba. Discover the Barceló Aruba hotel in Palm Beach, a privileged location with calm waters and white sand to enjoy unique moments. Guests can watch truly idyllic sunrises and sunsets from its 373 rooms, which all feature a balcony or terrace. The wonderful Barceló Aruba resort, in Palm Beach, is home to the Royal Level Barceló Aruba, a boutique hotel that offers a luxurious and sophisticated experience, with unique and exclusive services. A true paradise!
All-Inclusive Vacations at Barceló Aruba Hotel
The Barceló Aruba Hotel is a beautiful all-inclusive family resort in Aruba. The rich and assorted dining choices of its 6 restaurants and 3 bars will satisfy the most demanding palates with international cuisine, buffet, à la carte service, and appetizers. This resort offers the opportunity to enjoy maximum relaxation, either with a refreshing swim in its spectacular pool or basking in the Caribbean sun. Located in the heart of the Caribbean, the Barceló Aruba Hotel stands out for its spectacular sports offering, linked to the heavenly beach where it's located. It's the perfect spot for leisure and nightlife, with a fabulous casino and live music. Those who celebrate their wedding at the Barceló Aruba Hotel will find an ideal setting and top services for your special day.

name: JOIA Aruba by Iberostar
description:
You’ll find the spectacular JOIA Aruba by Iberostar just in front of Eagle Beach; it’s situated in a breathtaking spot in the Southern Caribbean, offering exceptional service. Picture yourself swimming in the infinity pool while enjoying stunning views of the ocean, or relaxing at the pool bar without ever leaving the water.
Unwind with a rejuvenating spa session and indulge in the diverse culinary offerings, including the incredible breakfast buffet, two specialty restaurants, three bars, and the hotel’s Star Café. There’s something for everyone, both within the hotel and nearby. You can tee off at Tierra del Sol, Aruba’s only professional 18-hole golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones II, explore the beautiful beaches, or simply relax in the hotel’s luxurious facilities.

name: Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort & Casino
description: Welcome to the Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort & Casino, an oceanfront hotel overlooking the stunning Caribbean coastline on Palm Beach. Enjoy an unforgettable getaway or family vacation with endless outdoor activities. Relax in our two pools, including zero-entry areas for children, or lounge under a palapa on Aruba's longest beach. Indulge in a massage at the beachfront eforea spa, try your luck at the casino, or work out in the gym while enjoying breathtaking ocean views. Savor diverse dining experiences at our various restaurants and bars. Sunset Grille offers premium steaks, chops, and fresh seafood. Unwind at Mira Solo with small bites and Caribbean cocktails while enjoying spectacular views of cascading waterfalls and Palm Beach. Enjoy poolside favorites and tropical cocktails at the casual, open-air Gilligan's Seafood Shack. The resort fee includes internet access, various water activities (such as stand-up paddle boards and kayaks), fitness classes (including meditation, yoga, and dance), bicycle rentals, and refillable water bottles at stations throughout the property.

Welcome to Renaissance Wind Creek Aruba Resort
Find pure bliss at our Aruba resort
In the heart of Oranjestad, Aruba, Renaissance Aruba Resort & Casino's breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea provide an exceptional setting for an unforgettable getaway. Whether you choose our renovated, adults-only beachfront hotel in Aruba or the secluded Renaissance Ocean Suites, your well-being is our top priority, and we look forward to providing activities for you to safely explore Oranjestad and nearby adults-only Flamingo Beach and Wind Creek. In minutes, our beachfront resort in Aruba water taxi brings you to our 40-acre private island where flamingos roam and relaxing treatments await at Spa Cove. Our 24-hour Wind Creek casino is a high-energy way to test your luck. Our downtown Aruba hotel has a vast array of restaurants and bars that serve everything from handcrafted cocktails to authentic steaks, the perfect dining experience is never far away. All of this and all that Oranjestad, Aruba has to offer, including access to world-class fishing, snorkeling and diving, are here for your pleasure.

name: Divi Aruba Phoenix Beach Resort
description: This hotel lies just 10 minutes away from the capital Oranjestad, and 5 minutes from Queen Beatrix international airport. It is situated on the famed Palm Beach, and backed by a private wildlife sanctuary. The modern and colourful hotel is rivalled only by its extraordinarily beautiful white beach. Guests can relax amongst palm trees, straw huts and hammocks, enjoying the view of the Caribbean Sea. The hotel itself adds to the Caribbean feeling with its authentic décor and numerous amenities. There are 101 suites and studios over 14 floors. Further facilities include a lobby, a hairdresser, a bar, a nightclub, a restaurant, conference facilities and public Internet (charges apply). Amenities include room and laundry service and a car park. The rooms feature colourful Caribbean décor and have a sea view. They are fitted with a bathroom/shower and a hairdryer, have a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a video recorder and fully equipped kitchen with an oven and a tea/coffee maker. The air conditioning is individually adjustable and all rooms offer a balcony or a terrace. In the outdoor complex there are 2 swimming pools with integrated children's pools, and sun loungers are laid out ready for use. There is an entertainment programme for children. <}0{>In order to relax, guests can make use of the hot tub, health spa and massage service. Sports enthusiasts can try their hand at aerobics, go to the gym, dive to explore wrecks sunk during the Second World War, windsurfing, go on cycle tours, play squash, and also play golf or tennis nearby. Guests can also go shopping or visit the casinos.

Boasting an exceptional beachfront location it offers unrivalled on-site facilities, amenities and activities. Fans of the fairway can play a round on the top-rated golf course, while those who prefer water-based activities can try some snorkelling or deep-sea fishing. Those searching for a new experience can try beachfront rock-climbing, while the guests who simply want relax can grab a chair next to the two outdoor swimming pools and spend their days with a chilled drink by the side and a good book in hand. name: Radisson Blu Aruba
description: Radisson Blu Aruba is a 4-star, all-suite resort offering the largest all-suite accommodations in Aruba, designed for travelers who value space, comfort, and functional design. The resort features 193 suites with a European-inspired aesthetic, created for a residential-style stay. Accommodations start at approximately 800 square feet (75 square meters) and range from one- to three-bedroom layouts, including a distinguished collection of penthouses suited for both short and extended stays. Guests enjoy a rooftop infinity pool, fully equipped fitness center, spa services, an on-site gift shop, and distinctive boutique dining concepts, including Don Esteban Gourmet, a Spanish tapas venue, and Blu Tap Cider, the Caribbean’s first dedicated cider bar. Radisson Blu Aruba is the only LEED-certified hotel building in Aruba, with sustainability integrated into the resort’s construction and daily operations through energy-efficient systems, water-conservation initiatives, waste-reduction programs, and the use of locally sourced materials. BLU Signature Experiences further enhance the stay through complimentary wellness and creative activities developed in partnership with local artists and wellness practitioners.

name: Eagle Aruba Resort
description: It's all about you at Eagle Aruba Resort & Casino – from friendly, tailored service to every imaginable amenity you and your family need for an unforgettable vacation in Aruba. The Eagle Aruba Resort & Casino is located about five minutes walk from the powder white Eagle Beach. Eagle Beach was named the best beach in the world in TripAdvisor's Traveler's Choice 2021. Eagle Beach has been ranked among the top 5 beaches in the world for the past five years. We are just 10 minutes from the airport, 5 minutes from Oranjestad, Aruba's capital, and less than 5 minutes from one of the Caribbean's most exclusive shopping areas, offering a variety of dining options. Choose from 362 one-, two-, or three-bedroom suites. Each of the luxurious villas is a private oasis of comfort and tranquility, with air conditioning, a kitchen, a large living room, and a balcony or patio encompassing the oasis swimming pools. The bar offers refreshing drinks while you dip in one of the 3 pools. Slide down the 150-foot water slide with your kids or take the plunge yourself (you know you want to!). Try your luck at our slots and table games at the Hotel Casino while enjoying a tropical cocktail and live music.

name: Tamarijn Aruba All Inclusive
description:
Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and an outdoor tennis court. This property also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. If you're ready for some gaming fun, you can hop on the complimentary casino shuttle. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Satisfy your appetite at Paparazzi Restaurant, one of the property's 5 restaurants. Visit one of the 3 bars/lounges, 2 beach bars, and 2 poolside bars for a refreshing drink. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 236 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. name: TRYP by Wyndham Aruba Adults Only Hotel
description: Welcome to Tryp By Wyndham Aruba, where modern comfort meets vibrant island experiences in the heart of Palm Beach. Designed for travelers seeking both relaxation and connection, this contemporary hotel offers 96 thoughtfully designed rooms equipped with everything you need for a seamless stay. Each room features a coffee and tea maker, smart TV, mini fridge, and a range of modern amenities that bring convenience and style together. Guests can enjoy the best of both worlds with access to a refreshing pool area and a dedicated beach space along the stunning shores of Palm Beach. Whether you prefer lounging poolside or feeling the soft sand beneath your feet, both locations offer food and drink service so you can indulge without interruption. What truly sets the hotel apart is its focus on creating memorable, hands-on experiences. Guests are invited to participate in a variety of complimentary interactive workshops designed to bring a touch of Aruba’s culture and fun to your stay. Learn the art of crafting cocktails in a lively mixology class, create your own unique souvenir to take home, feel the rhythm in a steel drum session, or unwind with a rejuvenating yoga class. With many more activities available, there’s always something engaging to discover. At the core of the experience is a strong commitment to exceptional service. The team places guest satisfaction as its top priority, ensuring every moment—from arrival to departure—is smooth, welcoming, and personalized. Whether you're visiting Aruba for relaxation, adventure, or a bit of both, Tryp By Wyndham Aruba delivers a dynamic and memorable stay infused with comfort, culture, and attentive hospitality.

name: Courtyard By Marriott Aruba Resort
description: Dip into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools or enjoy other recreational amenities, which include a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. Enjoy international cuisine at Allegra Bistro, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a garden view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Grab a drink at the swim-up bar while enjoying a refreshing dip in the hotel pool. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 192 air-conditioned rooms featuring microwaves and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. name: Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort
description: This hotel is centrally located beside one of the most beautiful beaches in Aruba. It is approximately 5 minutes from the centre of Oranjestad and some 15 minutes from Reina Beatrix airport. The high-rise area with shops, restaurants, and casinos is a short walk from the establishment. Constructed in Dutch colonial style in 1989, the beach hotel comprises a total of 72 spacious and air-conditioned studios and suites with 1 or 2 bedrooms. The Dutch architect Jan Hubert designed the building, which is generously laid out, and offers a cosy inner courtyard, as well as breath-taking sea views. Within the complex, leisure options include a swimming pool with a waterfall, and cocktail or theme parties with live entertainment, also take place occasionally.

name: MVC Eagle Beach Aruba
description: MVC Eagle Beach offers an intimate environment for you to relax to the fullest while on Aruba. A very warm welcome by our friendly staff will make you feel at home. This charming and quaint little hotel offers you value for money, friendly hospitality, tranquillity, basic yet tastefully newly decorated rooms and most importantly; an excellent beach escape with its location right across the most beautiful beach of Aruba Eagle Beach. The hotel is ideally located on Aruba, just a 10-minute drive from downtown Oranjestad and a 15-minute drive from the Reina Beatrix International Airport. The busy High Rise hotel area (Palm Beach) is just a couple minutes driving away and either Palm Beach or Oranjestad are easy accessible by bus. The nearest bus stop can be found very close to MVC Eagle Beach.

name: Holiday Inn Resort Aruba
description: The Holiday Inn Resort® Aruba-Beach Resort &Casino, is the best beachfront hotel located in Palm Beach, the glamorous and high-rise area of Aruba. Experience a unique atmosphere surrounded by an exotic world of shopping and sizzling nightlife. Relax in our beachside pools or experience the adventure with thrilling water sports. At the end of the day, enjoy an exquisite dinner at one of our five top restaurants. Our ideal location provides easy access to the island’s top attractions such as Palm Beach Plaza, Tierra del Sol Golf Course, Arikok National Park and The Butterfly Farm. Also, Queen Beatrix International Airport is located less than 8 miles away making it just a short ride from your arrival or departure point. Whether you want a romantic retreat, a family vacation or just a little downtime, the Holiday Inn Resort Aruba offers you a unique experience. Children under 11 years old eat free from the kids menus (lunch & dinner) and if accompanied by parents. If breakfast is included Children can eat from full buffet.

name: voco Surfside Aruba by IHG
description: This exclusive resort boasts a great position in the paradisiacal island of Aruba, just across the street from the beautiful Surfside Beach. This elegant property is conveniently located close to Oranjestad city centre and within easy reach from the airport and the cruise harbour. Thus, this is the ideal choice of accommodation for both business and leisure travellers, and especially recommendable for honeymooners or couples. Guests have the opportunity to stay in different types of guest rooms and suites, all of them fully equipped and tastefully appointed with contemporary and charming features. All of them count with a private balcony or terrace and upgrade includes extra space for added comfort and convenience. Visitors may enjoy a relaxing dip at the outdoor swimming pool, located in the centre of the hotel's courtyard, and afterwards taste a delicious meal or cocktail.

description: This low-rise resort offers a friendly atmosphere and warm Aruban hospitality. Deluxe accommodations feature decorated rooms with balconies nestled amidst lush tropical gardens. Located approximately one mile from the beach, the resort is conveniently situated within walking distance of major shopping malls in the Palm Beach area, as well as drugstores, supermarkets, nightclubs, bars, and medical offices. The rooms are fully equipped and decorated in neutral colors with a homey style to ensure a pleasant and comfortable stay.

name: Aruba Boutique & Art Hotel BW Signature Collection
description: Aruba Boutique and Art Hotel- a curated haven located within walking distance of the beach. Designed to cater to art enthusiasts and adventurous travelers, the hotel features a captivating art gallery, offering a unique and immersive cultural experience. Undoubtedly an appealing choice for those looking to avoid the large hotels and stay somewhere cozier and more intimate.
